issues.description: `detect_errors` has an inconsistent return type between the template and the specification/solution. The problem statement specifies it returns a 1D binary array (good shots encoded as 1), and the solution returns a NumPy array (`npt.NDArray[np.int8]`), but the template type hint says it returns `list[int]`. This can mislead students and cause type/usage inconsistencies in downstream code.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template signature to `def detect_errors(...) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8]:` (or `npt.NDArray[np.bool_]`) and update the template docstring to match the problem statement wording (1 indicates no error detected).

issues.description: `build_msd_circ`'s template docstring incorrectly describes the second returned list as measurement indices of the distilled state, while the problem statement requires (and the solution implements) returning the indices of the destructive X-basis measurements of the 15 tetrahedral-code block qubits (in qubit order). This ambiguity can cause students to return the wrong indices/order.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template docstring for `build_msd_circ` to state the second list is the measurement indices of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits measured destructively in the X basis (MRX), ordered to match the code qubit ordering.
